note: Hand-written questions. The generator never writes this file; see scripts/build_question_bank.py for how authored and generated items are merged.

items.prompt: Adjoa wants to estimate 398 + 205. (a) Round each number to the nearest hundred. (b) Estimate the sum. (c) Explain why your estimate is close to the exact answer.
items.answer: (a) 400 and 200. (b) About 600. (c) 398 and 205 are each close to the number they were rounded to, so their sum is close to 600 - the exact answer is 603.

items.prompt: A whole orange is cut into 4 equal parts. (a) What fraction is each part? (b) Explain what the fraction means. (c) How many quarters make one whole orange?
items.answer: (a) 1/4. (b) The orange was cut into 4 equal parts and one part is one quarter of the orange. (c) 4 quarters.

items.prompt: (a) How many faces, edges and vertices has a cube? (b) Write one way a cube and a cylinder are different.
items.answer: (a) 6 faces, 12 edges, 8 vertices. (b) A cube has flat faces and straight edges; a cylinder has two circular faces and a curved surface, so it can roll.

items.prompt: Name one thing in your school that is about 1 metre long and one thing that is about 1 centimetre long. Explain how you chose each one.
items.answer: Any sensible referents, for example the width of a doorway (about 1 m) and the width of a fingernail (about 1 cm). I compared each object with a metre rule or a ruler.
